attchmntText: Electrosteel Castings Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Electrosteel Castings Limited has disclosed the audio link of a conference call held on 13 November, 2026 at 4.00 pm IST. The call discussed Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings. The company previously intimated this schedule on 07 November, 2026. The audio recording is available as Concall-Electrosteel Castings Ltd-13112026.mp3. This disclosure is made under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The filing was signed by Indranil Mitra, Company Secretary.

attchmntText: Electrosteel Castings Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Completion of Tenure of Mr. Amrendra Prasad Verma as Non- Executive Independent Director of the Company w.e.f. December 21, 2026.
voiceSummary: Electrosteel Castings Limited approved its unaudited consolidated and standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The Board noted the cessation of directorship of Mr. Amrendra Prasad Verma as an Independent Director effective 21 December 2026, following the completion of his second and final term. The Board approved the re-appointment of Mr. Umang Kejriwal as Managing Director and Mr. Mayank Kejriwal as Joint Managing Director, both effective 1 April 2027, for a term of five consecutive years. Their remuneration is approved for three consecutive years, subject to shareholder approval. The auditor's report highlights qualified conclusions regarding pending legal matters involving coal block cancellation and investments in ESL Steel Limited, noting that impacts are not ascertainable pending final adjudication.

attchmntText: Electrosteel Castings Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Electrosteel Castings Limited announced that its Board of Directors approved the introduction of a Voluntary Retirement Scheme 2026 for workmen at the Khardah Unit during a meeting held on 13 November 2026. The company stated that the scheme is believed to be mutually beneficial for the workmen and the organization. Details regarding the implementation status and financial impact will be communicated later in accordance with the company's materiality policy. No other disclosures under SEBI Master Circular No. SEBI/HO/CFD/PoD2/CIR/P/0155 dated November 11, 2024, are applicable.

attchmntText: Electrosteel Castings Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Electrosteel Castings Limited filed a presentation for Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings. H1 FY27 consolidated total income was Rs. 3,023 Cr with EBITDA at Rs. 278 Cr. Q2 FY27 revenue from operations stood at Rs. 1,520 Cr. EBITDA margin was 8.9% in Q2 FY27. Promoter stake increased to 54.53% in Q2 FY27. The company acquired 100% stake in T.I.S. Services S.p.A. in July 2025. Credit rating is AA / A1+. Net debt to equity ratio is 0.13x. Book value per share is Rs. 96.

attchmntText: Electrosteel Castings Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Electrosteel Castings Limited has scheduled a conference call for Friday, 13 November, 2026, at 4.00 pm IST to discuss Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings. The event is hosted by E&Y. Management representatives including Mr. Madhav Kejriwal, Mr. Sunil Katial, Mr. Rajesh Daga, and Mr. Gaurav Somani will participate. Dial-in details are provided for domestic and international participants. The information is also available on the company website at www.electrosteel.com.
